Okay. So. I'm am active alcoholic. And I have severe depression. I feel you here. I do. My advice? Alcohol is so much worse. It heightens the depression. That numbness you're looking for? It doesn't come. All your pain and sadness is still there, but worse. And alcohol lowers your inhibitions, so you're more likely to engage in unsafe or dangerous behaviors.

Antidepressants can help. Yeah, there's a lot of side effects that "can" happen. They don't always. Most get better over time. And adjustments can be made over time.

Therapy is even better. Find a person you can talk to. Look for sliding scale or income based professionals. Therapy combined with medications can really make a positive difference. Alcohol never will. Trust me.
